fusions.name: Crater Landing
fusions.desc: A leap that lands as a blow dealing 16 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Shockwave Thump
fusions.desc: Slams down, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunch
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 35% for 12 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Brute Rebound
fusions.desc: When you cover a long distance on foot, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
